paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
Ika taru sotong, tyang madan taru sotong, don tyang panes, tamba raga rodoh,
don tyang tutuh, pada wekas kulit babakan, madan taru pule, babakan tyang panes,
mangratus madan taru kalyasem, babakan tyang panes, tamba margga,

[Lembar 2]
// yah sampun mara-marta tityang, ring weddan taru pramaṇa, hing brahmaṇa wi[tidak terbaca]
ñcaketrang tityang ring taru, madan kuñit, 19400, ring tegal, [tidak terbaca] //
// [tidak terbaca] //
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Itulah pohon sotong (jambu biji), hamba bernama pohon sotong, daun hamba berkhasiat hangat/panas, sebagai obat sakit rodoh (diare/gangguan perut), daun hamba digunakan sebagai tutuh (obat tetes/oles), selanjutnya kulit kayu (babakan) yang bernama pohon pule, kulit kayu hamba berkhasiat panas,
bercampur dengan pohon yang bernama kalyasem, kulit kayu hamba berkhasiat panas, sebagai sarana pengobatan.

[Lembar 2]
Demikianlah penjelasan hamba dalam pustaka Taru Pramana, bagi sang brahmana... penjelasan mengenai tumbuhan bernama kunyit... di tegalan...
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
That is the sotong (guava) tree, I am named taru sotong, my leaves are warm in character, medicine for body weakness/abdominal ailments (rodoh), my leaves are applied as a drop/lotion (tutuh), followed by bark named taru pule, my bark is warm in character,
blended with the tree named kalyasem, my bark is warm in character, as a medicinal treatment.

[Lembar 2]
Thus is my explanation in the Taru Pramana text, to the brahmana... description regarding the plant named turmeric (kunyit)... in the garden/field...

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Daun taru sotong yang berkhasiat panas/hangat diolah dan digunakan sebagai tutuh (obat tetes/oles) untuk mengobati sakit rodoh.

itaḥ pangrakṣa kulawan hayaḥ viniṣṭi pwa yaḥ yi hadā lwing sakit mwang prakṛti
vriti lawan pitutuḥ kalpawṛkṣa ikā [tidak terbaca] sampun katampak winarahi pratiṣṭha
tan bhraṣṭa dening bhūta yakṣa rakṣasa prajāpati .1. haḥ [tidak terbaca] tatwa

[Lembar 2]
|| yan hanā upadrawa ring tanaya manuṣa mangkā maliḥ punya dharmā mukti widyā mā-
rgga hitā puṣṭi rakṣa iti mantra pūjā 189 200 wiśeṣa kasumbha

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Inilah pelindung sanak keluarga bilamana terserang berbagai macam penyakit serta keadaan yang timbul, beserta petuah kalpawriksha tersebut ... telah dipahami, diajarkan, dan diteguhkan agar tidak dibinasakan oleh bhuta, yaksa, raksasa, dan prajapati. 1. Ah ... hakekat.

[Lembar 2]
Jika ada bencana/kemalangan pada anak manusia, demikian pula kebajikan dharma, menikmati pengetahuan sebagai jalan kesejahteraan, pemeliharaan, dan perlindungan. Demikianlah puja mantra ... utama kasumbha svaha.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
This is the protection for family members when afflicted by various kinds of illness and physical conditions, along with the teachings of the kalpavriksha ... which have been received, taught, and established, so as not to be destroyed by bhutas, yakshas, rakshasas, or prajapatis. 1. Ah ... essence.

[Lembar 2]
If there is misfortune befalling mortal children, likewise the merit of dharma, enjoying knowledge as a path to welfare, nourishment, and protection. Thus the ritual chant/mantra ... supreme kasumbha svaha.

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Teks berisikan ajaran mantra perlindungan spiritual/magis (pangrakṣa) dari gangguan penyakit dan makhluk halus (bhūta, yakṣa, rakṣasa), bukan formula racikan obat herbal fisik.

paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
... tya mangkana, tiyang taru pule dona panes, babakannira dumĕlada, anggon tamban basang seba, ulig don puletikang madu, inum.
... tiyang taru kaliyasĕm, babakannira panes, anggon tamban basang lara, inum.
... tiyang taru soñcwaran, tĕgĕsna taru jambu, donnyane panes, anggon loloh tamban tiwang mencret, donnyane ulig, campur tasik, inum.

[Lembar 2]
... taru tĕpĕs, donnyane tis, anggon boreh panes ...
... tiyang taru kalyasĕm ...
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
... Demikianlah, saya pohon pule, daunnya berkhasiat hangat/panas, kulit batangnya sedang (dumĕlada), digunakan untuk obat sakit perut kembung/begah, lumatkan daun pule dengan madu, lalu minum.
... Saya pohon kaliasem, kulit batangnya berkhasiat hangat, digunakan sebagai obat sakit perut, diminum.
... Saya pohon jambu (sotong), daunnya hangat, digunakan sebagai ramuan loloh (obat minum) untuk mengatasi diare/mencret, daunnya dihaluskan/dilumatkan, dicampur dengan garam, lalu diminum.

[Lembar 2]
... Pohon tepes, daunnya berkhasiat dingin, digunakan sebagai boreh pereda panas/demam ...
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
... Thus, I am the pule tree; its leaves have a warm energy, its bark is neutral/moderate, used as medicine for abdominal discomfort/bloating; crush the pule leaves with honey, and drink.
... I am the kaliasem tree; its bark has a warm energy, used as medicine for stomach ache, drink it.
... I am the guava tree (jambu/sotong); its leaves are warm in nature, used as an oral herbal drink (loloh) for diarrhoea/mencret; crush the leaves, mix with salt, and drink.

[Leaf 2]
... The tepes tree, its leaves are cool in nature, used as an external paste (boreh) for fever/heat ...
